intro: Micronesia has about 110,000 people speaking many languages.

chapters.title: People
text: Chuukese, Pohnpeian, Yapese and Kosraean are among the languages; English is official. Most people are Christian.

chapters.title: Palikir
text: Palikir, on Pohnpei, is the capital.

keyTerms.meaning: A person from the Micronesia region.
